headline: Savills Forecasts UK House Prices to Fall 1.5% Amid High Mortgage Rates
summary: Property firm Savills stated that UK house prices are expected to drift lower and fall by 1.5% next year, with the housing market unlikely to recover until 2028 due to higher mortgage rates linked to the Middle East conflict.
why: UK property market forecasts reflect consumer borrowing costs, housing affordability, and broader macroeconomic headwinds facing residential real estate.
